summary: Gold Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K on August 5, 2026, reporting its second-quarter and first-half 2026 operating results. The press release highlights record revenue and gold equivalent ounces, an 80% increase in total revenue and land agreement proceeds to $7.9 million for Q2, and adjusted EBITDA of $5.6 million. The company acquired an additional 0.875% NSR royalty on the Ren project for $6.25 million and post-quarter-end royalties on Sterling and Granite Creek for $0.8 million. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation; the royalty acquisitions are ordinary-course portfolio activity.
